question: Identify the voice in "has engendered a workforce proficient in qualifications but deficient in adaptability".
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ***Option 4: Active voice***

 
 
• In the **active voice**, the subject of the sentence performs the action. In the phrase "has engendered a workforce...", the subject (found earlier in the sentence: "This schism") is the one performing the action of "engendering&quo
